recipes.title: Follow the mouse pointer smoothly
q: make my sprite follow the mouse
how do i make it chase the mousse pointer
sprite go where my cursor is
steps: Green flag: the sprite keeps checking forever.
If it is not touching the mouse yet, it turns to face the mouse and moves 5 steps.
Want it faster? Use a bigger number like 10.

recipes.title: Spin around when clicked
q: make my sprite spin when i click it
how do i make it spinn around when clicked
turn in a circle when i press on it
steps: When you click the sprite, it plays a Pop sound.
It turns 10 degrees, 36 times. That makes one full circle!
At the end it faces right again.

recipes.title: Grow and shrink like a heartbeat
q: make my sprite grow and shrink
how do i make it pulse like a hart
get bigger then smaller again and again
steps: Green flag: the sprite starts at normal size.
It grows a little 10 times, then shrinks back 10 times.
Forever makes it keep pulsing. Smaller waits = faster pulse.

recipes.title: Bounce off the edges
q: make it bounce off the walls
how do i make my sprite bounse on the edge
keep moving and hit the sides
steps: Green flag: the sprite points at an angle so it moves diagonally.
Forever it moves 5 steps.
If it touches the edge, it bounces back the other way.

recipes.title: Fade in and out forever
q: make my sprite fade in and out
how do i make it go invisable slowly
ghost effect that comes and goes
steps: Green flag: the ghost effect starts at 0, so you can fully see the sprite.
It adds ghost 20 times until it is almost invisible.
Then it takes the ghost away again. Forever repeats it!

recipes.title: Jump to a random spot every second
q: make my sprite go to a random place every second
teleport randomly over and over
how do i make it jump around randum
steps: Green flag starts a forever loop.
The sprite jumps to a random spot on the stage.
Then it waits 1 second and does it again.

recipes.title: Say hello when clicked
q: make my sprite say hello when i click it
how do i make it talk when clicked
speech bubble hi when i press it
steps: When you click the sprite, it plays a Pop sound.
Then it says Hello! in a speech bubble for 2 seconds.
Change the words to anything you like!

recipes.title: Ask your name and say hi
q: make it ask my name and say hi
how do i ask a question and use the anser
sprite says hello to whatever name i type
steps: Green flag: the sprite asks your name and waits for you to type.
Your words are saved in the answer block.
Join sticks Hello and your answer together, and the sprite says it!

recipes.title: Count how many times you click
q: count how many times i click my sprite
how do i make a click counter
number goes up evry time i tap it
steps: Make a variable called clicks first.
Green flag: clicks starts at 0 and shows on the stage.
Each time you click the sprite, clicks goes up by 1 with a Pop!

recipes.title: Countdown from 10 to 0
q: make a countdown from 10
how do i count down to zero
10 9 8 blast off timer
steps: Make a variable called count first.
Green flag: count starts at 10.
11 times: the sprite says the number, waits 1 second, and takes 1 away.
After 0 it shouts Blast off!

recipes.title: Change colour with the keys
q: change my sprite colour with the keys
how do i make it a diffrent color when i press a key
rainbow colors with arrow keys
steps: Right arrow: the colour effect goes up by 25.
Left arrow: the colour goes back down by 25.
Space: all effects are cleared, so it looks normal again.

recipes.title: Draw a trail that follows the mouse
q: draw with the mouse like a pen
how do i make a paint trail where my mouse goes
drawing game with the mowse
steps: Use a tiny dot costume for this sprite.
Forever the dot follows the mouse.
While you hold the mouse button, it makes clones that stay behind like paint!
Space wipes all the paint by restarting.

recipes.title: Jump with the space key
q: make my sprite jump when i press space
how do i make it jumpp
hop up and come back down
steps: When you press space, the sprite goes up 10 steps, 10 times.
Then it comes back down the same way.
Bigger numbers = a higher jump!

recipes.title: Fall with gravity and land
q: make my sprite fall down with gravity
how do i make it fall and stop on the grownd
drop from the sky and land
steps: Make a variable called y speed first.
The sprite starts at the top. Every moment, y speed gets 1 smaller, so it falls faster and faster.
When it gets low (y below -120), it lands: it stays at -120 and stops falling.

recipes.title: Walk left and right and flip
q: walk left and right with arrow keys
how do i make him flip when he goes left
my sprite is upside down when walking left
steps: Green flag: left-right rotation stops the sprite from going upside down.
Right arrow: face right and move 5.
Left arrow: face left (it flips!) and move 5.

recipes.title: Move in 8 directions with WASD
q: move with w a s d keys
how do i go diagonal with wasd
top down movment controls
steps: Forever the sprite checks all 4 keys.
W goes up, S goes down, A goes left, D goes right.
Press two keys together, like W and D, to move diagonally!

recipes.title: Shoot a ball with clones
q: shoot a ball when i press space
how do i make bullets with clones
fire lots of balls from my player
steps: Put this on a Ball sprite. Your hero sprite must be called Player.
The real Ball hides. Space makes a clone.
The clone jumps to the Player, shows, and flies right until it hits the edge, then deletes itself.

recipes.title: Enemy moves toward the player
q: make the enemy chase my player
how do i make a monster folow me
bad guy moves to the player
steps: Put this on the Enemy. Your hero sprite must be called Player.
Green flag: the enemy starts in the top corner.
Forever it turns to face the Player and moves 2 steps, so it slowly chases you!

recipes.title: Collect a coin and get points
q: collect coins and get score
how do i pick up a coin and get a point
when player touches coin score goes up
steps: Put this on the Coin. Make a variable called score. Your hero must be called Player.
Green flag: score starts at 0 and the coin goes to a random spot.
When the Player touches the coin: +1 score, a Pop, and the coin jumps somewhere new!

recipes.title: Lose a life when touched
q: lose a life when the enemy touches me
how do i make lifes go down
health goes down when i get hit
steps: Put this on your Player. Make a variable called lives. The bad guy must be called Enemy.
Green flag: you start with 3 lives.
When you touch the Enemy: lose 1 life, hear a Zap, and flash ghostly for 1 second so you don't lose all lives at once.

recipes.title: Game over when lives reach zero
q: game over when my lives are 0
how do i end the game when i have no lifes
stop everything when lives run out
steps: Put this on your Player. You need the lives variable from the lose-a-life recipe.
Green flag: the sprite waits until lives is 0.
Then it plays a Zap, says Game Over!, waits 2 seconds and stops everything.

recipes.title: Timer that counts up
q: make a timer that counts up
how do i show how many seconds i played
stopwatch that goes 1 2 3
steps: Make a variable called time first.
Green flag: time starts at 0 and shows on the stage.
Forever: wait 1 second, then add 1 to time.

recipes.title: Keep a high score
q: make a high score
how do i save my best scor
remember the highest points
steps: Make two variables: score and high score.
Do NOT reset high score on green flag, so it stays between games.
Forever: if score is bigger than high score, high score becomes the new score!

recipes.title: Next level when score hits 10
q: go to next level when score is 10
how do i make levels
change level after 10 points
steps: Make a variable called level. You need the score variable too.
Green flag: start on level 1 and the first backdrop.
Each time score reaches 10: level goes up, the backdrop changes, and score goes back to 0.

recipes.title: Play a sound when clicked
q: play a sound when i click my sprite
how do i make a noise when clicked
click it and it goes pop
steps: When you click the sprite, it starts the Pop sound.
It also grows a bit and shrinks back, like a button.
Pick any sound you like in the menu!

recipes.title: Background music that loops
q: play background music forever
how do i loop my song
music that keeps playing in my game
steps: Add a music sound in the Sounds tab, then pick it in the menu.
Green flag: the volume is set to 50 so it is not too loud.
Forever plays the sound until it ends, then starts it again.

recipes.title: Change the backdrop with keys
q: change the background with a key
how do i switch backdrops
next scene when i press right arrow
steps: Add a few backdrops to the Stage first.
Right arrow: go to the next backdrop.
Space: go back to the first backdrop.

recipes.title: Drag the sprite to move it
q: drag my sprite with the mouse
how do i pick it up and move it
make it dragable
steps: Green flag: the sprite is set to draggable.
Forever: if the mouse is touching it AND the button is held down, it sticks to the mouse.
Let go of the button to drop it!

recipes.title: Show and hide with keys
q: hide my sprite when i press a key
how do i make it disapear and come back
show and hide with arrows
steps: Green flag: the sprite starts visible.
Down arrow: the sprite hides.
Up arrow: the sprite shows again with a Pop!

recipes.title: Glide to random spots
q: make my sprite glide around randomly
how do i make it slide to random places
float around the screen by itself
steps: Green flag starts a forever loop.
The sprite glides for 1 second to a random x and a random y.
It rests for half a second, then glides somewhere new.

recipes.title: Orbit around the centre
q: make my sprite go around in a circle
how do i make it orbit the middle like a planit
move round and round the center
steps: Green flag: the sprite will not turn its picture, it only moves.
Forever: it jumps to the middle, turns 3 degrees, then moves 120 steps out.
Doing that again and again makes a circle! Bigger move number = bigger circle.

recipes.title: Move in a zig-zag
q: make my sprite move in a zig zag
how do i make it go up and down while moving
zigzagg across the screen
steps: Green flag: the sprite starts on the left side.
It goes up-right 15 times, then down-right 15 times. That is one zig-zag!
When it reaches the right side, it jumps back to the left.

recipes.title: Wrap around the screen edges
q: go off one side and come back on the other
how do i make it wrap around the screen
sprite comes back from the other side
steps: Green flag: the sprite keeps moving right.
If it goes too far right, it jumps to the left side.
The same for left, top and bottom, so it never gets stuck!

recipes.title: Stop everything with space
q: stop everything when i press space
how do i make a stop key
freeze the whole game with spase
steps: Green flag: the sprite spins forever so you can test it.
When you press space, all sounds stop.
Then stop all ends every script in the whole project!

recipes.title: Broadcast to start the game
q: start the game with a message
how do i use brodcast to start
click play button and game starts
steps: Script 1 goes on a Play button sprite: click it and it sends message1, then hides.
Script 2 goes on your Player: it hides at the start.
Script 3 on the Player: when it gets message1, it shows up in the middle and says Go!

recipes.title: Title screen then start the game
q: make a title screen before the game
how do i make a start menu
press space to start screen
steps: Make 2 backdrops: a title one first, then the game one.
Script 1 goes on a Title sprite: it shows the title and waits for space.
When you press space, it hides, switches to the game backdrop and sends message1.
Script 2 goes on your Player: it appears when message1 arrives.

recipes.title: Pause the game with P
q: pause my game when i press p
how do i make a pawse button
press p to stop and p again to play
steps: Make a variable called paused first.
Script 1: pressing P flips paused between 0 and 1. It waits for you to let go so it does not flicker.
Script 2: the sprite only moves when paused is 0, and says Paused when it is 1.

recipes.title: Speed up as time goes on
q: make my game get faster over time
how do i make it speed up
get harder and harder evry few seconds
steps: Make a variable called speed first.
Script 1: speed starts at 2, then the sprite moves by speed and bounces forever.
Script 2: every 5 seconds, speed goes up by 1. Faster and faster!

recipes.title: Make rain fall with clones
q: make it rain in my game
how do i make lots of raindrops fall
falling drops with clones
steps: Use a small raindrop costume. The real drop hides and makes a clone every 0.1 seconds.
Each clone starts at the top at a random x spot and shows.
It falls down until it reaches the bottom, then deletes itself.

recipes.title: Delete clones at the bottom
q: delete clones when they reach the bottom
my game is laggy with too many clones
how do i get rid of clones at the botom
steps: The real sprite hides and makes a clone every second.
Each clone falls from the top at a random spot.
Forever it checks: if it is near the bottom, it deletes itself. This keeps your game fast!

recipes.title: Walls you cannot walk through
q: make walls my player cant go thru
how do i stop walking into the wall
maze walls that block me
steps: Put this on your Player. Draw a sprite called Wall.
Each arrow key moves the Player 5 steps.
If the Player touches the Wall, it steps back 5 the other way, so it can never go inside!

recipes.title: Button that changes the scene
q: make a button that changes the background
how do i make a next button
click button to go to next scene
steps: Put this on a Button sprite.
When you click it, it squishes a little like a real button and goes Pop.
Then the stage switches to the next backdrop.

recipes.title: Enemies fly in from the right
q: make enemys come from the right side
how do i spawn lots of enemies
bad guys fly across the screen
steps: Put this on the Enemy. The real one hides and makes a clone every 1 to 2 seconds.
Each clone starts on the right side at a random height.
It flies left until it reaches the left edge, then deletes itself.

recipes.title: Blink when you get hit
q: make my player blink when hit
how do i make it flash when the enemy touches
flicker after getting hurt
steps: Put this on your Player. The bad guy must be called Enemy.
When the Player touches the Enemy, it plays a Zap.
It hides and shows 5 times very fast, so it blinks!

recipes.title: Ask a quiz question
q: make a quiz game
how do i check if the anser is right
ask a math question and say correct
steps: Make a variable called score first.
The sprite asks a question and waits for you to type.
If your answer is 7, it says Correct! and you get a point. If not, it tells you the right answer.

recipes.title: Roll a dice when clicked
q: make a dice that rolls
how do i get a random number 1 to 6
roll the dise when i click
steps: Make a variable called roll first.
Click the sprite: it flashes random numbers 10 times, like a spinning dice.
Then it picks the real number from 1 to 6 and says it!

recipes.title: Shake the screen
q: make the screen shake
how do i do a camra shake
earthquake effect when something explodes
steps: Press space to test it (or send message1 from your game).
The camera jumps to a tiny random spot 10 times, really fast.
At the end it goes back to the middle, so everything is normal again.

recipes.title: Aim at the mouse and shoot
q: make a cannon that points at my mouse
how do i shoot where the mouse is
turret aim and fire
steps: Green flag: the sprite always turns to face the mouse.
Press space to make a clone.
The clone flies forward the way it was pointing until it hits the edge, then deletes itself.

recipes.title: Jump with real gravity
q: jump with gravity like a real game
how do i make a smooth jump that falls back
platformer jump only on the grownd
steps: Make a variable called y speed first.
Every moment y speed gets smaller, so the sprite falls.
When it reaches the ground (y = -120) it stops. Only then can space make it jump up with speed 15!

recipes.title: Bouncy physics ball
q: make a real bouncy ball
how do i use fisics blocks
drop a ball and it bounces on the floor
steps: Green flag: the stage gets a floor and the ball goes to the top.
Physics is turned on with a circle shape, and bounce is set to 70.
Forever ticks the physics, so the ball falls and bounces by itself!

recipes.title: Camera follows the player
q: make the camera follow my player
how do i make the screen scroll with me
big world camra moves with sprite
steps: Put this on your Player.
Arrow keys move the Player around.
Forever the camera jumps to the Player, so you always stay in the middle of the screen!

recipes.title: Make your sprite dance
q: make my sprite dance
how do i do a dance move
dancing with costumes when i press space
steps: Give your sprite 2 or more costumes.
Press space: a sound plays and the sprite hops up and down 4 times.
Each hop shows the next costume, so it looks like dancing!

recipes.title: Two sprites talk to each other
q: make two sprites talk
how do i make a conversashun
one sprite says hi and the other answers
steps: Script 1 goes on the first sprite: it says hi, then sends message1 and waits.
Script 2 goes on the second sprite: when it gets message1, it answers.
After the answer, the first sprite talks again. That is a story!

recipes.title: Random colour when clicked
q: change to a random color when i click
how do i make it a random colour
click and it turns a new colur
steps: When you click the sprite, it goes Pop.
The colour effect is set to a random number from 0 to 200.
Every click gives a surprise colour!

recipes.title: Grow when the mouse is over it
q: make it get bigger when my mouse is on it
how do i do a hover effect
button grows when mouse touches
steps: Green flag starts a forever loop.
If the mouse is touching the sprite, it becomes size 120.
If not, it goes back to size 100. Great for menu buttons!

recipes.title: Save answers in a list
q: save what i type in a list
how do i add things to a lisst
make a list of my favorite fruits

Green flag: the list is emptied and shown on the stage.

recipes.title: Tell a random joke from a list

random joke when i click

script: Why did the cookie cry? Its mom was a wafer so long!

what time is it sprite

It joins the hour, a colon and the minute together, like 4:30.

recipes.title: Pet that follows the player

how do i make a sprite folow another sprite
little buddy goes where my player goes
steps: Put this on the Pet. Your hero sprite must be called Player.
Forever the Pet glides to where the Player is, taking half a second.
Because it is a bit slow, it always walks right behind you!

recipes.title: Win when you reach the goal
q: win the game when i touch the flag
how do i make a finish line
you win screen when reach the goal
steps: Put this on your Player. Draw a sprite called Goal.
The Player waits until it touches the Goal.
